state: Implemented C# development behavior; Developer qualification recorded in planning/logging/template-api/README.md
syntax: C# interpolation and .NET formatting; no separate named-placeholder grammar
attributes: Explicit typed values are independent structured attributes, never interpolation bindings or automatically inferred expression names. Existing scope precedence applies.
templateMetadata: Generated positional format; source expression names are not guaranteed
evaluation: Caller, in C# expression order, even for filtered/stopped calls. Exceptions from expressions precede the logger method. This handler does not short-circuit evaluation.
ownership: Built-in scalars are immutable snapshots; strings/spans are bounded owned text. Other types format once on caller and retain only text. Freeze copies parts, never caller dictionaries or formatting objects.
rendering: Consumer after claim, once before processing callbacks and initial byte projection. Existing output/lifecycle behavior applies. Internal output-only qualification seams format synchronously.

bounds.standardNumericPrecisionScope: Listed owned built-in scalars only. Other framework and user types use caller-side formatting; their execution and intermediate allocations are outside the library bound.
bounds.overflow: Omit unsupported-size part or excess text/parts and mark truncated; preserve existing aggregate encoded-entry projection

backendFormatFailure: Public frontend: Incoming.Failed and covered loss observations, without faulting unrelated writers. Internal output-only qualification: synchronous InvalidEvent/InterpolationFormatFailed.
frontend: No change to publication, P01, consumer polling or lifecycle boundaries
